jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

Klinkhammer Intralogistics GmbH is a successful, family-owned enterprise based in Nuremberg, Germany. Renowned for its expertise in innovative intralogistics solutions, the company combines cutting-edge mechanics and control technology to develop tailored software solutions for automated logistics centers. With a strong focus on quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Klinkhammer Intralogistics has established itself as a trusted partner in the intralogistics industry. The company's commitment to growth and excellence has been recognized by the Bavarian Ministry of Economic Affairs, making it one of the 50 fastest-growing medium-sized companies in Bavaria.

About The Role

We are seeking a dedicated Fachprojektleiter Softwareentwicklung (m/w/d) for WMS C#/.NET in automated intralogistics to join our team in Nuremberg. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in automation, warehouse logistics, and system integration combined with modern software development practices. You will be responsible for managing complex software projects from conception through to successful deployment at customer sites. As a key member of our team, your programming skills will remain vital, and you will actively contribute to the development process. You will work closely with internal departments and clients, ensuring that project goals are met efficiently and effectively. Your role will also involve direct on-site support during go-live phases, primarily within the D-A-CH region, requiring travel and flexibility. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on innovative projects in a dynamic environment, fostering your technical and leadership skills.

Qualifications

To succeed in this role, candidates should possess a completed university degree or equivalent qualification alongside several years of experience in software development. Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS), logistics solutions, or material flow solutions (MFR) is highly desirable, especially within automated intralogistics environments. Candidates must demonstrate strong proficiency in C#/.NET and familiarity with modern web technologies, including Blazor. Knowledge of agile development methodologies and tools such as Azure DevOps is essential. A solid understanding of Clean Code principles, unit testing, and experience with ORM and mocking frameworks are required. Willingness to travel for project phases, particularly go-live activities, is necessary. Excellent communication skills in German (C1 level) and good English skills are expected. Additionally, candidates should have an interest in considering economic and customer-centric aspects alongside technical solutions.

Responsibilities

Manage and oversee software projects from initial requirements gathering through development, testing, and successful deployment.
Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables while coordinating resources and timelines effectively.
Collaborate closely with internal teams and clients to ensure alignment and successful project execution.
Ensure the quality, functionality, and practicality of developed software solutions.
Provide on-site support during go-live phases, predominantly within the D-A-CH region, ensuring smooth implementation and customer satisfaction.
Engage actively in full-stack software development, contributing code and innovative ideas to project teams.
Bring creative and efficient solutions to technical challenges, fostering continuous improvement and innovation.

Benefits

Joining Klinkhammer Intralogistics offers numerous advantages including the stability and security of a well-established family-owned company. The company has been recognized as one of Bavaria’s top growth companies, reflecting its commitment to innovation and success. Employees benefit from diverse and engaging projects that prevent routine monotony, as well as an open and professional organizational culture. The onboarding process is structured to support smooth integration into the team. Flexible working hours and options for remote work are available, along with a modern office environment featuring amenities such as a canteen, coffee bar, rooftop terrace, grill area, and recreational facilities like a kicker. The company also organizes social events and offers an attractive benefits package, including free parking, electric vehicle charging stations, and bicycle storage. Employees can take advantage of corporate benefits and participate in a vibrant, collaborative work environment.

Equal Opportunity

Klinkhammer Intralogistics GmbH is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diversity and equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation. Our goal is to create a respectful and supportive environment where every employee can thrive and reach their full potential.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (1 Year Contract)
jobs.description:
About the Role We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and enhance modern digital products that support the education sector.

You will develop web applications that improve operational processes and digital experiences for educators, students, and other stakeholders. Working across both frontend and backend development, you will collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, and users to translate real-world needs into secure, scalable, and user-friendly solutions.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building products end-to-end and want to use technology to create meaningful impact in education.

Key ResponsibilitiesFull Stack Development Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain production-grade web applications supporting education-related services and operations.
Build new product features and enhance existing functionality based on user and business requirements.
Translate requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions.
Contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from solution design through deployment and ongoing support.

Frontend Development Develop responsive, accessible, and intuitive user interfaces using modern frontend technologies.
Build reusable UI components and optimise applications for performance and usability.
Work closely with product managers and designers to deliver high-quality experiences for educators, students, and operational users.

Backend & API Development Develop and maintain APIs, backend services, and business logic supporting application workflows.
Implement authentication, authorisation, and role-based access controls.
Integrate applications with databases, enterprise systems, and external services.
Ensure backend services are secure, reliable, performant, and scalable.

Data & Workflow Solutions Design data models, application workflows, and business process automation.
Develop features supporting task management, reporting, operational visibility, and decision-making.
Maintain data integrity, security, and traceability across applications.

Quality, DevOps & Engineering Practices Develop automated tests and follow secure coding and software engineering best practices.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving engineering standards.
Support CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Continuously improve application reliability, performance, and maintainability.

Product & User Collaboration Engage with users and stakeholders to understand challenges within education and operational environments.
Participate in prototyping, usability testing, and iterative product development.
Gather feedback and identify opportunities to improve products, workflows, and user experience.

Requirements 3–5+ years of experience in software engineering, full stack development, or application development.
Proven experience building and delivering production-grade web applications.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with a modern frontend framework such as React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
Backend development experience using Node.js, Python, Java, .NET, or Go.
Good understanding of RESTful APIs and service-oriented architectures.
Experience implementing authentication, authorisation, and application security controls.
Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
Good understanding of data modelling, database design, and query optimisation.
Familiarity with AWS or Azure cloud environments.
Experience working in Agile or product-oriented development teams.

Good to Have Experience developing digital products for the education or public sector.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment automation.
Experience with Docker or other containerisation technologies.
Understanding of application monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.
Knowledge of accessibility and responsive web development practices.
Experience working directly with users to translate business needs into technical solutions.

What We’re Looking For Passion for using technology to solve real-world problems and improve experiences in education.
Strong ownership and accountability for delivering quality outcomes.
Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working with evolving requirements and ambiguity.
Strong problem-solving skills with a pragmatic approach to software engineering.
Collaborative, proactive, and willing to contribute ideas and challenge assumptions constructively.
Strong focus on product quality, usability, and delivering practical solutions.
